operation.statement: Each enrollment decision is recorded. A confirmed decision results in exactly one enrollment-confirmed notification, and a rejection because the course is full (COURSE_FULL) in exactly one enrollment-rejected notification; a repeat request (ALREADY_ENROLLED) results in none.

steps.objectName: Only a confirmed decision is notified
steps.label: Statement
steps.before: Each enrollment decision is recorded; a confirmed decision results in exactly one notification to the student, a rejected one in none.
steps.after: Each enrollment decision is recorded. A confirmed decision results in exactly one enrollment-confirmed notification, and a rejection because the course is full (COURSE_FULL) in exactly one enrollment-rejected notification; a repeat request (ALREADY_ENROLLED) results in none.

operation.name: Confirmations and full-course rejections are notified

steps.label: Name
steps.before: Only a confirmed decision is notified
steps.after: Confirmations and full-course rejections are notified

operation.statement: A request for a full course is recorded as rejected with COURSE_FULL, and the student receives exactly one enrollment-rejected notification for that enrollment.

steps.objectName: A rejected enrollment is not announced
steps.label: Statement
steps.before: A request for a full course is recorded as rejected with COURSE_FULL, and the student receives no notification for it.
steps.after: A request for a full course is recorded as rejected with COURSE_FULL, and the student receives exactly one enrollment-rejected notification for that enrollment.

rationale: Students turned away from a full course should hear about it (they may pick another course); a repeat request stays quiet because the student already holds the seat.
